title: Data Scientist

Job title : Data Scientist Location: Lyon, M&S Accelerator Work Arrangement: Hybrid (Three days from office and two days from home) About the job As a Data Scientist within our Digital Manufacturing & Supply (M&S) Accelerator , you'll take ownership of turning real-time signals from our factories and labs into decisions that matter — working at the intersection of drug development, advanced manufacturing, and cutting-edge AI. Ready to get started? Join Sanofi's Manufacturing & Supply team right in the heart of Lyon, in a vibrant startup-style environment in the city centre. You'll support 12 blockbuster launch teams and 40 global factories across R&D and M&S, helping accelerate the launch of new medicines, build digitalised "Lighthouse" factories, and drive manufacturing performance improvements — all while enjoying an easy commute and a great work-life balance in one of France's most dynamic cities. About Sanofi: We're an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people's lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives. Main responsibilities Partner with business teams to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions, working with a good degree of autonomy Own the ingestion, cleaning, and harmonisation of IoT and sensor data from a mixed estate — some fully connected and streaming, plenty of it legacy, manual, or messy. A meaningful part of the role is data cleaning and wrangling: it's the foundation everything is built on, and doing it well is genuinely high-impact here Design and deliver time-series models — forecasting, anomaly detection, and monitoring — on streaming sensor data to drive manufacturing performance and quality Design, build, and support real-time and streaming data pipelines together with engineers and MLOps, and help bring legacy sites up to a usable state Write highly optimised, production-ready code, taking models from experiment through to deployment Scope, define, and deliver AI-based data products end to end, using data analysis, visualisation, and storytelling Be accountable for the robustness of the AI solutions you deliver, applying responsible AI practices (monitoring, explainability, trustworthiness, ethics) Contribute to — and help raise the bar within — the global data science community of practice Support junior data scientists and analysts with informal guidance and code review You'll also work across the wider AI portfolio — including LLMs, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and agentic AI workflows — as our products increasingly blend sensor intelligence with GenAI. Strong here is a plus, but IoT and time-series is the core of this role. About you You're a capable data scientist with a few years under your belt, genuinely excited by physical-world data — sensors, signals, and the machines that produce them. You can take a problem from vague business need to deployed model with limited hand-holding, and you've got a keen eye for improvement opportunities. Experience: Hands-on track record working with IoT data, sensor streams, or time-series (this is what we care about most) Demonstrated experience applying machine learning to real problems, ideally involving signals or temporal data Experience developing deployable code and taking models to production in an agile environment You're not put off by messy, real-world data — a big part of this role is turning inconsistent legacy data into something usable, and doing it well is where a lot of the value sits Knowledge of the pharmaceutical or chemical domain is a huge advantage — understanding of manufacturing processes, GxP, or lab environments will set you apart Soft skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills Experience working with multiple teams to drive alignment and results Service-oriented, flexible, positive team player Self-motivated, takes initiative Problem solving & critical thinking Technical skills: Strong Python , and comfortable with at least one database system — time-series databases (e.g. InfluxDB, TimescaleDB) especially valued Solid command of time-series methods — forecasting, anomaly detection, signal processing — on streaming data Working knowledge of streaming / real-time data technologies (e.g. Kafka, Spark Streaming, MQTT or similar) Strong ML foundations: supervised/unsupervised learning, deep learning, with a solid grasp of the underlying theory Comfortable working in cloud and high-performance computing environments (AWS, GCP, Databricks, Apache Spark) Good software engineering practices — version control, testing, CI/CD, orchestration Experience with data visualisation tools (Power BI, Tableau, Streamlit, Plotly, seaborn, or similar) Experience handling sensitive data in critical environments (healthcare, etc.) Familiarity with LLMs, RAG, or agentic workflows is a plus, not a requirement Education: Master's degree (or PhD) in engineering, computer science, mathematics, physics, statistics, or a related quantitative discipline with strong coding skills — backgrounds in chemical/process engineering, control systems, or signal processing are especially welcome Languages: English and French What we offer you: A fixed salary over 12 months, supplemented by a short-term incentive, as well as a collective variable compensation based on Sanofi Group results. Because taking care of our employees is also our mission: Benefits & Well-being: Quality health insurance, extended maternity/parental leave (18/14 weeks), enhanced support in case of illness, teleconsultation and second medical opinion covered by Sanofi, as well as many other wellness programs to discover here . Work-Life Balance: 31 days of paid leave + RTT depending on your status, remote work up to 2 days/week Transportation: Public transport coverage up to 80% Savings & Retirement: Group Savings Plan and PERCOL with employer matching, and PERO Professional Development: Internal and international mobility opportunities, learning & development opportunities And more: platforms dedicated to peer-to-peer recognition & service exchanges between Sanofi employees (carpooling, home exchanges, etc.), numerous CSE benefits... Why choose us? We provide a highly open and collaborative environment, with the chance to work with a world-class team. You will be able to: Learn what it takes to build a service with a truly global reach Be part of an organisation that values diversity, inclusion, and the richness of different backgrounds and experiences Engage in meaningful work that combines the challenges of pharma, manufacturing, environmental matters, and technical fie [...]

title: Strategy & Insights Analyst
desc:
We are the people who give possibilities purpose BD is one of the largest global medical technology companies in the world. Advancing the world of health™ is our Purpose, and it’s no small feat. It takes the imagination and passion of all of us—from design and engineering to the manufacturing and marketing of our billions of MedTech products per year—to look at the impossible and find transformative solutions that turn dreams into possibilities. 

 Job Description Job Responsibilities Strategy & Business Insights Conduct analyses that support commercial strategy, portfolio management, customer engagement, and growth initiatives. Evaluate business challenges, opportunities, and market dynamics to identify actionable recommendations. Perform opportunity assessments, trend analyses, scenario evaluations, and business case development. Support strategic projects by gathering and analyzing data from multiple internal and external sources. Translate analytical findings into business implications, opportunities, risks, and recommended actions. Assist in the development of executive-ready presentations, summaries, and strategic recommendations. Customer & Market Intelligence Analyze customer, market, competitive, and healthcare industry trends to identify emerging opportunities and risks. Support customer insight initiatives by synthesizing qualitative and quantitative research findings. Monitor healthcare utilization, market share, competitive activity, reimbursement changes, and commercial performance trends. Assist with segmentation, customer journey analysis, voice-of-customer efforts, and market research projects. Develop insights that help improve commercial effectiveness and customer engagement strategies. Strategic Decision Support Decision Intelligence Support Support business stakeholders by gathering and organizing evidence needed to evaluate important business decisions. Assist in developing decision briefs, learning agendas, opportunity assessments, and recommendation frameworks. Synthesize findings from commercial, operational, financial, market, and customer data sources. Evaluate business scenarios and strategic options using analytical and structured problem-solving techniques. Help monitor outcomes and measure the impact of decisions and initiatives after implementation. AI Enablement & Innovation Support the identification and testing of AI-enabled solutions that improve analytical effectiveness and business decision-making. Develop and refine prompts, workflows, and use cases using approved enterprise AI tools. Assist with pilot programs that apply AI to research, insight generation, evidence synthesis, and commercial decision support. Document successful approaches and support adoption across the organization. Monitor emerging AI capabilities and industry best practices. Analytics & Visualization Develop dashboards, analytical views, and visualizations that communicate findings clearly and effectively. Partner with Business Intelligence team members to leverage existing data assets, analytic products, and reporting environments. Ensure analyses are supported by accurate, trusted, and appropriately governed data. Translate complex findings into clear visual stories suitable for business stakeholders and leadership audiences. Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner with Sales, Marketing, Clinical, Finance, Operations, and Business Intelligence stakeholders. Support priority projects through strong organization, communication, and analytical execution. Work effectively across teams to gather requirements, validate findings, and align on recommendations. Contribute to a culture of continuous learning, innovation, curiosity, and business impact. Proven Proficiencies and Capabilities Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills. Ability to synthesize information from multiple sources into clear business insights. Demonstrated ability to communicate findings to technical and non-technical audiences. Experience developing presentations and executive-ready business recommendations. Strong business acumen and intellectual curiosity. Ability to navigate ambiguity and make progress with incomplete information. Strong organizational and project management skills. Ability to influence stakeholders through data, logic, and effective communication. Interest in emerging analytics, artificial intelligence, and decision-support technologies. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams. Qualifications 3-5 years of experience in Analytics, Business Intelligence, Market Research, Commercial Analytics, Strategy, Customer Insights, Consulting, or related fields. Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree preferred. Experience with Power BI, Excel, Salesforce, SQL, or related analytical tools. Demonstrated ability to translate data and research into actionable business recommendations. Experience supporting business strategy, customer insights, market research, or commercial effectiveness initiatives preferred. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Healthcare, MedTech, life sciences, or related industry experience preferred. Experience with AI-enabled analytics, advanced analytics, or emerging analytical technologies is a plus. At BD, we prioritize on-site collaboration because we believe it fosters creativity, innovation, and effective problem-solving, which are essential in the fast-paced healthcare industry. For most roles, we require a minimum of 4 days of in-office presence per week to maintain our culture of excellence and ensure smooth operations, while also recognizing the importance of flexibility and work-life balance. Remote or field-based positions will have different workplace arrangements which will be indicated in the job posting. For certain roles at BD, employment is contingent upon the Company’s receipt of sufficient proof that you are fully vaccinated against COVID-19. In some locations, testing for COVID-19 may be available and/or required. Consistent with BD’s Workplace Accommodations Policy, requests for accommodation will be considered pursuant to applicable law. Why Join Us? To find purpose in the possibilities, we need people who can see the bigger picture, who understand the human story that underpins everything we do. We welcome people with the imagination and drive to help us reinvent the future of healthcare. At BD, you’ll discover a culture in which you can learn, grow and thrive. We believe that when people connect in person, we learn faster, collaborate more deeply, and build a stronger culture. Join us and enjoy a culture where face-to-face collaboration supports your learning, your progress, and your success. To learn more about BD visit https://bd.com/careers . Becton, Dickinson, and Company

title: Career Outcomes Data Analyst
desc: American University is a student-centered research institution located in Washington, DC, with highly-ranked schools and colleges, internationally-renowned faculty, and a reputation for creating meaningful change in the world. Learn more about American University Department: Career Operations, Data & Systems Time Type: Full time Job Type: Regular FLSA Status: Exempt Work Modality: Hybrid 01 (On Campus 3-4 Days/Week) Union: SEIU Local 500 - Provost & Enrollment Division This position is part of a collective bargaining unit represented by SEIU Local 500 - Provost & Enrollment Division. That means the terms and conditions of your employment are governed by university policy (including the Staff Personnel Policies Manual) and any collective bargaining agreement entered into between American University and SEIU Local 500 - Provost & Enrollment Division. Job Description: Summary: The Career Outcomes Data Analyst leads the collection, analysis, interpretation, and communication of career outcomes and assessment data for the Career & Experiential Learning portfolio. This position provides analytical expertise to support the university's strategic commitments to student success, equitable access to high-impact experiences, and transparent post-graduation outcomes. Reporting to the Director of Operations, Data & Systems, the Career Outcomes Data Analyst transforms complex and decentralized data into actionable insights that inform continuous improvement, resource allocation, and institutional decision-making. Working in partnership with the Data & Career Systems Analyst, this position focuses on career outcomes, graduation census, program assessment, and strategic analytics related to student success beyond graduation. Essential Functions: 1.) Career Outcomes & Graduate Data Lead the design, administration, analysis, and reporting of graduate outcomes and first-destination data in alignment with national standards and best practices. Manage the Graduation Census process, including project planning, timelines, data collection, reconciliation, quality assurance, documentation, and reporting. Produce annual career outcomes reports and customized analyses for schools, academic programs, university leadership, accreditation efforts, and external stakeholders. Develop and maintain methodologies, definitions, and reporting standards that promote consistency, transparency, and comparability of outcomes data. Analyze trends in employment, graduate education, and post-graduation success and communicate findings to stakeholders. Define and monitor key performance indicators related to career readiness, experiential learning, student engagement, and post-graduation outcomes. Conduct ad hoc analyses to address strategic questions and support departmental planning and decision-making. 2.) Data Analysis & Visualization Analyze and integrate data from career systems, surveys, experiential learning programs, and institutional sources to support longitudinal and cross-functional analysis. Develop and maintain dashboards, scorecards, visual reports, and recurring reporting processes for diverse stakeholder audiences. Conduct equity-minded analyses to identify disparities in outcomes across student populations. Develop recommendations for programmatic, operational, and strategic improvements based on assessment findings. Translate complex analyses into actionable insights and recommendations for leadership and campus partners. Partner with the Operations and Data team to translate findings into clear, credible institutional narratives. 3.) Institutional Partnerships & Data Stewardship Collaborate with Institutional Research, Information Technology, Alumni Relations, Advancement, AU Abroad, and academic units to support outcomes reporting and assessment efforts. Partner with the Data & Career Systems Analyst to ensure reporting requirements are reflected in system design, data definitions, and reporting infrastructure. Contribute to data governance efforts through documentation, standards development, and responsible data-use practices. Support data quality, validation, and reconciliation processes related to outcomes and assessment reporting. Serve on relevant university committees and working groups. 4.) Communication, Training & Strategic Support Partner with the Operations and Data team to communicate findings through reports, presentations, visualizations, and institutional narratives. Support staff and campus partners in building data literacy and comfort using evidence to inform planning and continuous improvement. Provide consultation and guidance regarding outcomes data, assessment methods, and interpretation of findings. 5.) Other Duties & Strategic Initiatives Contribute to division and university-wide initiatives related to assessment, outcomes reporting, and strategic planning. Support emerging priorities related to career readiness, experiential learning, student success, and post-graduation outcomes. Perform other duties as assigned. Supervisory Responsibility: May supervise graduate assistants, student employees, or project‑based analysts supporting data collection and reporting efforts. Position Type/Expected Hours of Work: Full-time. 35 hours per week. Hybrid 1 work modality (on campus 3 - 4 days per week). Salary Range: $65,000.00 - $73,000.00 annually. Required Education and Experience: Bachelor's degree or equivalent. 2 - 4 years of relevant experience in data analysis, assessment, evaluation, or institutional research, preferably in higher education or student success contexts. Preferred Education and Experience: Master's degree in higher education, social or behavioral science, public policy, business analytics, data science, or a related field preferred. Additional Eligibility Qualifications: Demonstrated experience with survey design, data cleaning, and applied analysis. Strong proficiency in Excel and at least one data visualization or analytics tool. Ability to translate complex analyses into clear insights and recommendations for varied audiences. Familiarity with career outcomes reporting and career management platforms. Experience conducting equity‑focused analyses. Experience working in decentralized or matrixed organizations. Experience partnering with Institutional Research or academic units. Other Duties: Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice. Benefits AU offers a competitive benefits package. Click here to learn about American University's unique benefit options . Other Details Hiring offers for this position are contingent on successful completion of a background check. desc: Job Description: DXC ayuda a empresas globales a ejecutar sus sistemas y operaciones críticos para el negocio mientras moderniza la TI, optimiza las arquitecturas de datos y garantiza la seguridad y la escalabilidad en nubes públicas, privadas e híbridas. Contamos con más de 125.000 personas en más de 70 países, en las que nuestros clientes confían la entrega de tecnologías transformadoras para garantizar el éxito, la seguridad y el bienestar de empresas y personas en todo el mundo. Creamos soluciones y generamos mejores resultados para los clientes a lo largo de todo su entorno de IT combinando fortalezas y experiencia a nivel global. Descubre más sobre cómo ofrecemos excelencia a clientes y compañeros en DXC.com. En España somos uno de los principales líderes del mercado de TI. Contamos con cerca de 8.000 profesionales, distribuidos en trece localizaciones, con centros de excelencia en tecnologías de última generación como Cloud, Inteligencia de Negocio, IA o Automatización entre otras, que dan servicio a más de 200 clientes de todas las industrias tanto del sector público como privado. Trabajamos con las principales empresas del país que confían en nosotros para guiar y administrar sus agendas digitales y así transformar sus negocios. Desarrollamos políticas activas de diversidad e inclusión laboral de personas con discapacidad y estamos orgullosos de contar con una representación del 49% aproximadamente de mujeres profesionales. En DXC España buscamos un/a Analista de Reporting con experiencia avanzada en Power BI y Excel para unirse a nuestro equipo de Reporting y Business Intelligence y participar en un importante proyecto. Te encargarás de consolidar, automatizar y transformar información de diferentes fuentes en dashboards e informes para el seguimiento de indicadores operativos y de gestión. El objetivo principal es llevar un modelo de reporting basado en múltiples archivos Excel a una solución en Power BI centralizada, automatizada y visualmente intuitiva. También darás soporte puntual en el seguimiento y la coordinación de proyectos. Requisitos: Imprescindibles: • Experiencia avanzada en Microsoft Power BI: modelado de datos, visualizaciones y diseño de dashboards. • Dominio de DAX para medidas, cálculos complejos y KPIs. • Experiencia sólida en Power Query para transformar y preparar datos. • Nivel avanzado de Excel: fórmulas complejas, tablas dinámicas, tratamiento y consolidación de datos. • Experiencia integrando diferentes fuentes de datos en soluciones de reporting. • Capacidad para estructurar, depurar y transformar información heterogénea. Valorables: • Conocimientos de SQL. • Power BI Service: publicación de informes y actualización automatizada de datasets. • Experiencia en reporting de servicios y operaciones de IT. • Familiaridad con indicadores operativos, SLAs y seguimiento de proyectos. • Conocimientos básicos de metodologías y herramientas de Project Management. Idiomas: • Español: dominio profesional (imprescindible). • Inglés: nivel suficiente para entender documentación, interpretar información operativa y elaborar informes de IT. No se requiere un nivel oral avanzado. Competencias personales: • Perfil analítico, metódico y orientado al detalle. • Autonomía y organización en entornos de trabajo remoto. • Capacidad para convertir información compleja en informes claros y accionables. • Buenas habilidades de comunicación y documentación. • Orientación a la calidad, la mejora continua y la automatización. Funciones: Reporting y Business Intelligence (actividad principal): • Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener dashboards e informes interactivos en Power BI. • Consolidar y transformar grandes volúmenes de información que ahora están en múltiples archivos Excel. • Desarrollar cálculos, métricas e indicadores avanzados con DAX. • Usar Power Query para extraer, limpiar, transformar e integrar datos. • Construir modelos de datos eficientes, con información consistente, de calidad y trazable. • Extraer e integrar información de Jira y ServiceNow, solo para reporting y análisis. • Automatizar el reporting para reducir el trabajo manual y hacer los informes más fiables. • Colaborar con los equipos para entender sus necesidades y convertirlas en indicadores y visualizaciones. Soporte a la gestión de proyectos (actividad secundaria): • Apoyar el seguimiento de planificaciones, hitos y entregables. • Preparar documentación de seguimiento, actas y resúmenes ejecutivos. • Elaborar presentaciones en PowerPoint para reuniones de seguimiento y de gestión. • Colaborar puntualmente en la identificación y el seguimiento de riesgos, incidencias y acciones pendientes. ¿Por qué DXC? Vida en DXC En DXC te incorporarás a una empresa de referencia, con sólidos valores y una cultura people-first basada en la inclusión, el sentido de pertenencia y el aprendizaje. Encontrarás oportunidades reales de desarrollo profesional a través de un trabajo con impacto en proyectos punteros para clientes referentes del mercado, utilizando tecnologías líderes en el sector IT. Apoyamos la flexibilidad y la conciliación, fomentamos un excelente ambiente de trabajo e invertimos en el aprendizaje continuo a través de DXC University, con certificaciones ilimitadas. Actuamos con integridad y un fuerte compromiso con nuestros empleados, construyendo una cultura inclusiva con impacto en la comunidad. Además, es un lugar para construir a largo plazo, con estabilidad y un paquete competitivo de beneficios sociales, para que personas brillantes impulsen su carrera mientras ayudan a nuestros clientes a tener éxito. At DXC Technology, we believe strong connections and community are key to our success. Our work model prioritizes in-person collaboration while offering flexibility to support wellbeing, productivity, individual work styles, and life circumstances. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. title: Data Analyst / Business Analyst

Our mission is to safeguard the health of every resident and cultivate a city where everyone, regardless of age, background, or location, can achieve their optimal health. title: FSU Research Assistant, Bureau of Environmental Disease Prevention
desc: The mission of the Bureau of Environmental Disease Prevention is to prevent environmental disease in homes, communities, and the workplace, and to protect health by promoting healthy environments and health equity. The Bureau is comprised of four programs – Healthy Homes (HHP), Environmental Exposure Assessment and Education (EEAE), Poison Control Center (PCC), and the Office of Environmental Investigations (OEI). title: Strategy Analyst/Associate

We are seeking a Strategy Analyst/Associate to support the annual Strategic Planning process. This role will also contribute to critical strategic initiatives across our business units across all functions and geographies. In addition, the role will support inorganic initiatives and diligence, including M&A, equity investments, and other partnerships. Responsibilities Strategic Analysis : Conduct in-depth market research, competitive analysis, and trend identification to evaluate new growth opportunities and potential risks. Primary Research : Execute primary market research to inform strategy, assess market opportunities, and support new product planning. Secondary Research : Collect insights from a variety of sources for competitive and market intelligence. Data & Insights : Collect, analyze, and synthesize complex quantitative and qualitative data to generate actionable insights and support strategic recommendations. Communication : Prepare compelling presentations and reports for senior management and cross-functional teams, clearly articulating key findings, opportunities, and strategic options. Business Case Development : Build financial models and business cases to assess the feasibility and potential impact of strategic projects, including mergers, acquisitions, and new product launches. Project Support : Assist in the planning and execution of strategic projects across various functions, such as R&D, commercial, and operations. Track record of executing primary market research and synthesizing findings independently. Strong experience with secondary market research including competitive intelligence and market intelligence. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex ideas in a clear, concise, and professional manner. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize appropriately. Intellectual curiosity with respect to both technology and business Proactive mindset, attention to detail, and comfort with ambiguity Remote work will be considered Our mission is to inspire advances in bioprocessing as a trusted partner in the production of biologic drugs that improve human health worldwide. Focused on cost and process efficiencies, we deliver innovative technologies and solutions that help set new standards in bioprocessing. The estimated base salary range for this role, based in the United States of America is $128,000 - $185,000. Compensation decisions are dependent on several factors including, but not limited to an individual's qualifications, location, internal equity, and alignment with market data. Additionally, employees are eligible to participate in one of our variable cash programs (bonus or commission) and eligible roles may receive equity as part of the compensation package. All compensation and benefits information will be confirmed in writing at the time of offer.

title: AI Engineer
desc:
Cerebras Systems builds the world's largest AI chip, 56 times larger than GPUs. This architecture allows Cerebras to deliver industry-leading training and inference speeds; over 10 times faster than GPU-based hyperscale cloud inference services. 

This order of magnitude increase in speed is transforming the user experience of AI applications, unlocking real-time iteration and increasing intelligence via additional agentic computation.

Cerebras works with the leading model labs, global enterprises, and cutting-edge AI-native startups. OpenAI recently announced a multi-year partnership https://openai.com/index/cerebras-partnership/ with Cerebras, to deploy 750 megawatts of scale, transforming key workloads with ultra high-speed inference.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for an AI Engineer who loves building with new models, experimenting with developer tools, and writing about what they learn. You’ll create prototypes that demonstrate what fast inference makes possible, optimize the harnesses around models, and turn your findings into technical content that helps other developers build.

This is a hands-on role on our DevRel team. Technical writing is a core part of the job. You’ll take projects from an interesting question through implementation, testing, and a clear explanation others can follow. You should be as comfortable debugging an agent workflow or comparing model behavior as you are writing a tutorial or presenting a demo.




WHAT YOU’LL OWN

 - Technical writing: Write blogs, tutorials, walkthroughs, and practical guides grounded in your own experiments. Explain how things work, why implementation choices matter, and how developers can reproduce your results.

 - Prototypes and demos: Find original ways to showcase Cerebras fast inference. Build sample applications, notebooks, and interactive experiences that make the benefit tangible.

 - Harness optimization: Build and improve the code and workflows around models, including prompts, tool use, context management, orchestration, and evaluation. Identify bottlenecks and test ways to improve speed, reliability, and output quality.

 - Model experimentation: Try new models and investigate their capabilities, limitations, and fit for different tasks. Compare behavior on realistic workloads and turn useful findings into examples and recommendations for developers.

 - Evaluation and reproducibility: Design practical tests, measure results, and validate technical claims. Make your code easy to run and explain the assumptions, tradeoffs, and limitations behind your conclusions.

 - Launches and developer education: Partner with Product, Engineering, and New Media to create technically accurate launch examples, workshops, and stories. Present your work and help developers understand how to apply it.

 - Developer feedback: Engage with developers, troubleshoot integrations, and turn recurring questions and friction into improvements to examples, documentation, and the product experience.


SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

 - A strong portfolio of AI applications, prototypes, technical writing, tutorials, or other substantive developer-facing work.

 - Hands-on experience building with model APIs and debugging AI application workflows.

 - Excellent technical writing skills. You can turn a complex implementation or experimental result into a clear, useful explanation.

 - Experience working with agent harnesses or related workflows involving prompting, tool calling, context management, and evaluation.

 - An informed view of the AI developer ecosystem and curiosity about new models, frameworks, and emerging application patterns.

 - Strong technical judgment. You can design fair comparisons, verify results, and distinguish observations from assumptions.

 - Original ideas for demos and developer experiences, with a clear sense of what makes an example useful and engaging.

 - The ability to scope projects, ship independently, incorporate feedback, and collaborate with technical and creative partners.


PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

 - Experience optimizing latency, responsiveness, or reliability in AI applications.

 - Contributions to open-source projects, developer tools, or publicly available technical examples.

 - Experience teaching developers through workshops, talks, or live demonstrations.


PORTFOLIO

Please include links to code, prototypes, and technical writing you’ve created. Identify what you personally built or wrote, explain the problem you explored, and share the results or lessons learned.

Cerebras Systems
